notice: Conservative personal practice: eight contextually supported targets from the learner who reports living in China, travel experience, software work and podcast goals. No voice identity is asserted. General teacher feedback, other learners’ phrases, optional alternatives and ASR-only reconstructions remain in lesson readings and are not seeded as personal errors. Active vocabulary is a self-reported learning goal, not a grammatical error. No phonetic diagnosis is made from ASR.
